thresholds.brute_force_distributed: one username; failures from >=3 source IPs in trailing 60m; no success for that username in that interval
thresholds.brute_force_same_source: one source and one account; >=5 failures in rolling 60s; no matching success in window
thresholds.credential_stuffing: proposed: >=4 distinct failed usernames across >=4 source IPs on auth endpoint in rolling 60m; success ratio <=0.10
thresholds.generic_scan: >=75% 4xx and >=5 distinct paths from one source
thresholds.normalization: up to 3 repeated URL decodes, HTML entities, Unicode escapes, SQL comment stripping, whitespace collapse
thresholds.payload_signatures: SQLi/XSS/traversal signatures after up to 3 URL decodes
thresholds.priv_esc_proxy: >=5 distinct profile IDs from one source

normalization_contract_to_evaluate: repeated URL decode up to 3 passes
